name: Setsu-nyan no Goshujin-sama
original_name: セツにゃんのご主人さま
source:
Human shaped android pets become invented to heal people's hears. But soon they get prohibited and abandoned. 
Setsuna looks at the sky without knowing the reason why he is in this world. But soon he meets a master, and this encounter changes his life completely.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人形机器人宠物的发明是为了治愈人们的心灵。但很快他们就被禁止并被抛弃。
刹那看着天空，不知道自己为何来到这个世界。但很快他遇到了一位大师，这次相遇彻底改变了他的生活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
